definitions.explanation: A telecommunications or internet line; the physical or virtual connection used for data transmission or phone calls.

examples.japanese: {回線|かいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいて→混む：02574_komu⟧つながらない。
examples.english: The line is congested and I can't get through.

examples.japanese: {光回線|ひかりかいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えたら→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Speed improved after switching to a fiber-optic line.

examples.japanese: {災害時|さいがいじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電話回線|でんわかいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パンク→パンク：10537_panku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなく→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: During disasters, phone lines can become overloaded and it may become impossible to reach people.

notes:
USAGE:
{回線|かいせん} is used for both telephone lines and internet connections. It is a common term in everyday life when discussing internet service, phone contracts, or network issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {光回線|ひかりかいせん} (fiber-optic line)
- {電話回線|でんわかいせん} (telephone line)
- {回線|かいせん}{速度|そくど} (line speed)
- {回線|かいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧ (the line is congested)
- {回線|かいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to contract a line/connection)

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{海鮮|かいせん}→海鮮：05881_kaisen⟧ (seafood), which has the same reading.
